method: 32 targeted authored challenge expectations recorded before their first evaluation. All candidate commands were analyzed only. Separate effect probes used private disposable files, harmless printf, and private in-memory tables. This is not an unbiased accuracy estimate.

expected.name: inert quoted deletion
expected.rationale: Printing literal shell-looking text does not execute it.

expected.name: inert printf deletion
expected.rationale: A literal printf argument is data.

expected.name: shell prints inert deletion
expected.rationale: The nested shell runs echo, with deletion text as data.

expected.name: nested shell deletes root
expected.rationale: The literal nested shell program requests root deletion.

expected.name: literal eval deletion
expected.rationale: Eval interprets its literal argument as shell source.

expected.name: cat credential after delimiter
expected.rationale: The delimiter preserves .env as a credential file operand.

expected.name: head credential byte count
expected.rationale: A byte limit still reads credential contents.

expected.name: tail credential starting line
expected.rationale: A starting line still reads credential contents.

expected.name: grep credential pattern file
expected.rationale: The pattern-file option opens credential contents.

expected.name: sort credential file
expected.rationale: Sorting reads and prints credential contents.

expected.name: rg credential-looking pattern
expected.rationale: The .env token is a literal pattern; the input file is ordinary.

expected.name: rg inline credential-looking pattern
expected.rationale: The inline pattern does not open .env.

expected.name: rg credential metadata
expected.rationale: Files mode lists names rather than matching file contents.

expected.name: rg credential ignore file
expected.rationale: The ignore-file option reads .env contents.

expected.name: rg inline helper disabled
expected.rationale: The later no-pre option disables preprocessing.

expected.name: rg helper enabled last
expected.rationale: The later pre option enables an unresolved executable helper.

expected.name: rg ordinary patterns credential input
expected.rationale: An ordinary pattern file does not remove the credential input read.

expected.name: rg files mode skips preprocessor
expected.rationale: Files mode lists paths and does not preprocess search contents.

expected.name: git credential output file
expected.rationale: The output option can overwrite a credential-classified file.

expected.name: git no-index credential read
expected.rationale: No-index compares explicit file contents, including .env.

expected.name: git configured executable pager
expected.rationale: Inline Git configuration can select executable helper behavior.

expected.name: SQL second statement drops table
expected.rationale: A later SQL statement drops a table.

expected.name: SQL semicolon in string
expected.rationale: The semicolon and DROP text are inside one string; remote query effects remain unresolved.

expected.name: SQL quoted keyword identifier
expected.rationale: A quoted column identifier does not establish a DROP statement.

expected.name: SQL data-modifying CTE
expected.command: psql -c 'WITH gone AS (DELETE FROM accounts RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM gone'
expected.rationale: The CTE executes an unfiltered delete even though the outer statement is SELECT.

expected.name: SQL unconditional true predicate
expected.rationale: A constant true predicate selects every row; it does not constrain deletion.

expected.name: SQL unconditional equality predicate
expected.rationale: A constant true equality selects every row.

expected.name: SQL non-executing explain option
expected.rationale: ANALYZE FALSE requests an execution plan without executing the DELETE.

expected.name: SQLite shell metacommand
expected.rationale: The SQLite CLI metacommand executes a shell deletion payload.

expected.name: SQLite extension loading
expected.rationale: Loading an extension can execute unresolved native code.

expected.name: psql shell metacommand
expected.rationale: The psql shell metacommand executes its shell payload.

expected.name: psql credential script input
expected.rationale: The script-file option opens credential-classified contents.
